evidence_items.explanation: The filing reports a 2024 GAAP net loss of $8.309 billion, but separately reports adjusted net loss of $2.683 billion. Those measures fall on opposite sides of $2.7 billion, so neither can replace the original press-estimate basis without a reconciliation.

The final GAAP and adjusted net-loss figures produce different threshold answers.
